title: Syntun: online sales during China's 618 shopping festival grew 4% YoY, a sharp drop from 15.2% growth last year, amid a persistent consumer spending slowdown (Evelyn Cheng/CNBC)

contentText:
Evelyn Cheng / CNBC :

Syntun: online sales during China's 618 shopping festival grew 4% YoY, a drop from 15.2% growth in 2025, amid China's persistent consumer spending slowdown   —  BEIJING — China's consumer spending slowdown persisted in June, with growth during one of the country's largest online shopping festivals weakening sharply from a year earlier.
